name: All-frame color erase follows matching layers across different stacks and Undo preserves unrelated pixels
description: Sampled-color erase must change only uniquely matching Body layers when another frame has Lighting above Body, and Undo must restore exact original rasters.

Select frame 1, choose Erase Sampled Color, open its tool settings, and switch frame scope to All frames. Keep default family/tolerance settings.
Click the red artwork at pixel (3,3).
Download a Project Backup and inspect each layer PNG by decoding it in the runner/browser.

Verify Body pixel (2,2) has alpha 0 in all four frames. Hidden Lighting in frame-1 must retain exact original PNG pixels, including RGBA [255,0,0,51] at (2,2). Do not infer preservation from its visibility.
Use Undo last action, or focus the drawing canvas and press Ctrl+Z. Download another backup.
Verify every original Body pixel (2,2) is [255,0,0,255], and Lighting remains [255,0,0,51]. Compare all decoded pixel bytes with the original fixture where possible.
Redo the erase, Save, wait for Changes saved, and reload Studio.

Verify the erased Body pixels remain transparent and unrelated Lighting still matches its original raster. Report missing fixture/download/pixel assertions as BLOCKED or INCONCLUSIVE, never a visibility-only pass.
